messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: release-window v1.46.0 blocked — ci pipeline 4251 failing artifact-fetch step; 4/6 restores returned 416 Range Not Satisfiable. Auto-promo paused. See /ci/4251.logs
Zoe: hmm 416 on restores? that usually means partial object due to TTL GC on cache node or multipart truncation.
Liam: I see `Range end > object size` in storage logs. Cache shard gc ran ~3m ago. Could be aggressive TTL after a failed compact.
Carlos: Change window ends in 18m. Two choices: (A) rebuild & reupload (est ~16m) or (B) manual-promote last-stable v1.45.9. Which keeps SLAs?
ReleaseManager: Prefer manual-promote to avoid surprise user impact unless rebuild is <10m. Rebuild sounds risky given cache inconsistent. Any objections?
Zoe: +1 manual-promote. We should also capture an incident ticket and add a short canary.
build-bot: Pipeline 4251 artifact fetch errors: 416 x4, 200 x2. Affected mirrors: cache-a, cache-d returned 416.
infra-bot: Opened ticket INFRA-472 for cache shard TTL/compaction during writes. Marked P1 for release block.
Liam: Manual promote steps: `./deploy promote --tag v1.45.9 --canary 2% --pause-after-canary` I'll need ReleaseManager approval token to run.
ReleaseManager: Approving manual promote for this window. Token: RM-6136009999-APPROVED. Proceed with 2% canary then scale.
deploybot: Manual promote initiated by Zoe with token RM-6136009999-APPROVED. Canary 2% started. Note: auto-promo remains BLOCKED until INFRA-472 shows resolved and cache error rate <0.5% for 1h.
Zoe: Canary health checks passing first 5m. No new artifact errors observed on canary nodes.
Carlos: Adding release note: "Promoted v1.45.9 due to ci-cache TTL/compaction race causing partial restores for v1.46.0 artifacts; follow-up: avoid compaction during writes and add per-object size verification on restore."
Liam: After canary, scaling to 25% now. Will watch for 10m then complete full rollout.
build-bot: Canary logs: no 416 responses during canary window. Restore success rate 100% for canary nodes.
Zoe: Full rollout complete. Manual override recorded: `manual_promote_by=Zoe; tag=v1.45.9; reason=cache_ttl_compaction_race`.
infra-bot: INFRA-472: provider acknowledged compaction job overlap with writes, scheduling patch to respect write-locks. Owner assigned: Liam.
ReleaseManager: Closing the hold for this change window. Postmortem requested: owner Liam, due EOD. Auto-promo stays blocked until metrics improve. Thank you team :thumbsup:
